actions.eval: (() => { window.__t0 = performance.now(); window.__errs = (document.body.innerText.match(/Error · /g) ?? []).length; return { errorBlocksBefore: window.__errs, lines: document.body.innerText.split('\n').filter(l => /Error · |model|Model/.test(l)).slice(0, 10) } })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const n = (document.body.innerText.match(/Error · /g) ?? []).length; if (n > window.__errs) return { ms: Math.round(performance.now() - window.__t0), errorBlocks: n }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'no new error after 60 s' })()

(() => { const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => /^Error · /.test((e.innerText ?? '').trim())); const blocks = all.filter(e => !all.some(o => o !== e && e.contains(o))); return blocks.map(b => (b.parentElement?.innerText ?? b.innerText)); })()

(() => { const hits = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => /^Error · /.test((e.innerText ?? '').trim())); const el = hits.sort((a, b) => a.innerText.length - b.innerText.length)[0]; el?.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); return el ? el.innerText : 'no error on screen'; })()
